why: Inserting the narrow head+measurement binding made the model avoid cuts that separate a noun/verb head from an immediately following numeral/quantity, so many very-short pieces (≤3 and ≤5-word pieces) improved because measurements stayed attached to their heads. However that binding pushed cuts elsewhere (isolating determiners/pronouns or breaking enumerations) and produced small net harm over full sentences (≤99), so the overall H_set change is slightly negative and not significant.
lesson: When adding a binding to keep heads with immediately following numerals, ensure it doesn't force cuts that create single-word fragments or split coordinate/enumeration structure, since the rule helps very short pieces but can worsen longer-piece coherence.
